brief:
Three years have passed since the October 7, 2023 attack, with Gaza facing a broad Israeli military operation that has killed tens of thousands and repeatedly displaced residents, leaving them under siege and hunger, Shehab Wire reported. The report examines what the Palestinian Authority has provided to the territory during the conflict.

The assessment comes as Gaza continues to face severe humanitarian conditions amid the ongoing war and blockade.
